scope: Repository dates establish website records; only explicitly sourced work checkpoints are dated as development work.

milestones.title: Website foundation
milestones.summary: The initial company website was recorded. This establishes website work, not the date the company or its games began.

milestones.title: Thumb Command joins the website
milestones.summary: The world-defense presentation and its city artwork were added to the site.

milestones.title: A broader studio portfolio
milestones.summary: The portfolio and product pages were rebuilt around card games and original worlds.

milestones.title: Dragons, towns, and useful apps
milestones.summary: The GildenSpire website experience and the September portfolio additions document a growing lineup. These are website records, not app launch dates.

milestones.title: BooYang feeding and growth checkpoints
milestones.summary: The source notes and preserved article distinguish a September 11 feeding repair from the September 12 development build and its scoped checks.

milestones.title: Small repairs, better play
milestones.summary: The September 11–12 source notes record feeding, dragon movement and scoped app-behavior checks, with remaining limits kept in the articles.

milestones.title: The shared workbench opens
milestones.summary: The journal and product reading routes were published together, alongside repairs to the fixed Palace browser demo. The batch publication does not date every underlying task.

milestones.title: Sling Bling gets its new look
milestones.summary: New artwork and the October 20 development note reached the website. The game overhaul remained in development.
